entities.name: Dejan Zlatičanin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dejan Zlatičanin is a Montenegrin professional boxer. He is the first Montenegrin boxer to win a boxing world title, having held the WBC lightweight title from 2016 to 2017.
